title: CI interpreter coverage and shard timing
summary: Before pytest, each full shard measures the median of three local Python loops. Values above 0.05 seconds refuse as ci_runner_slow with the measured value, limit and recovery: re-run the failed GitHub Actions job. The refusal is retained in pytest-output.txt; the pytest step uses PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 for progress timestamps. Setup precedes admission, and later host degradation remains outside this check.
